ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) patches localized at the distal tips constituting approximately 15% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey to black central region spanning the fluke lobes. High-contrast white mottling and irregular geometric blobs are restricted to the far left and far right distal margins. Minor high-intensity punctate spots are scattered across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical vertex relative to the horizontal plane of the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing boundary, exhibiting irregular pixel-amplitude peaks particularly dense at the distal corners.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following a smooth arc from the distal tips inward toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular, high-contrast white clusters located at the extreme margins of both fluke tips, exhibiting topographical protrusion from the edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization clusters forming irregular white protrusions on the trailing and distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Avian silhouette (bird) perched on the upper-left margin of the left fluke lobe.
